pages.title: Ogre's Bane
pages.text: Granted by $(item)Toad Stew$() for 5 minutes. Your attacks deal 15% more damage to ogres of every rank, from Grunts to the Ogre King.

pages.title: Bogstride
pages.text: Worn while swimming in $(item)Boghide Boots$(). It is a marker for the boots' real gift: faster swimming and a longer breath. It fades a moment after you leave the water.

pages.title: Unyielding
pages.text: The full set of $(item)Bog Iron$() armor grants this when a hit lands hard enough. For 10 seconds you gain 4 armor, 2 toughness, 30% knockback resistance and 3 attack damage, and a shockwave pushes back everything within 4 blocks.$(br2)It cannot trigger again for 30 seconds.
